description:
A local-first personal AI for Windows with encrypted on-device memory.

VAND is a personal AI desktop app for Windows. It keeps personal memory in an encrypted file on the user's computer, supports multiple model providers, includes an offline mode, and is sold as a one-time lifetime purchase rather than a subscription.
- Added a dismissible lifetime-ownership prompt after a meaningful private briefing.
- Kept the trial usable and the desktop app telemetry-free.
